Name: Prophet's Kitchen Replacement
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
[size=3]A little retexture for the kitchen I made when I wanted something new for myself, and have decided to share it! 


[b]Update:[/b] With original intention and with request, I've uploaded a new version of the mod with different colour options, intended to match my additional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27903]dining set colours. [/url] These can be changed in the mods config, with option of Red, Green, Blue, Orange, Plain, Yellow, or Pink. Hope y'all enjoy! 

Like always people are free to use my assets elsewhere, just be sure to credit me :D

[size=3][url=https://bsky.app/profile/prophetmods.bsky.social]Come say hi on bluesky[/url] if you wanna see what I'm up to in the meantime! I'm a bit more responsive there

[/size]and if you would like to support me...
[url=https://ko-fi.com/prophetmods]I recently made a ko-fi ! All the cool kids are doing it[/url][/size]
